rationale: The agent authenticated the user correctly via name + zip, identified the two pending t-shirt orders, requested explicit confirmation including payment method, performed the modifications to the specified purple, S, v-neck, polyester variant, and accurately reported the resulting small price differences. However, earlier in the conversation the agent stated there were 11 available t-shirt options when the product data showed only 10 available variants. This is incorrect and constitutes stating information unsupported by the tools, which meets a fail condition despite the later order-handling being compliant and correct.
